title: Knowledge Portal webinar recording now available
summary: The recording of the August 11, 2022 Knowledge Portal webinar featuring Dr. Klaus Kaestner is now available.
bodyHtml: In this webinar, Dr. Klaus Kaestner of the University of Pennsylvania, presented a talk on "3D chromatin maps of the human pancreas reveal lineage-specific regulatory architecture of T2D risk".
